title: Pit and stint report
description: Pit and stint report — provisioned openlaps endurance operations dashboard.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: stint
list.label: Stint
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.title: Pit stops and open-stop status

targets.rawSql: SELECT entry_at AS time, duration_s AS "Stop duration", CASE WHEN is_open THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Open stop" FROM v_pit_stops WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(entry_at) ORDER BY entry_at

panels.description: An open stop is marked OPEN and never presented as completed.

panels.title: Per-driver consistency: median, spread, best, within 1%

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(crossed_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) AS "Median lap", max(lap_time_s)-min(lap_time_s) AS "Spread", min(lap_time_s) AS "Best lap", count(*) FILTER (WHERE lap_time_s <= best_lap * 1.01) AS "Laps within 1% of best" FROM (SELECT *, min(lap_time_s) OVER (PARTITION BY driver) AS best_lap FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND valid AND pit_status = 'track') paced GROUP BY driver

SELECT max(crossed_at) AS time, avg(fuel_used_l) AS "Mean fuel per lap", sum(fuel_used_l) AS "Total fuel" FROM v_lap_fuel WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND measurement_status = 'clean' GROUP BY driver ORDER BY driver

SELECT max(crossed_at) AS time, avg(lap_time_s) FILTER (WHERE pit_status = 'pit') - avg(lap_time_s) FILTER (WHERE pit_status = 'track') AS "In/out lap cost" FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) GROUP BY driver ORDER BY driver

panels.title: Driving time compliance

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(crossed_at) AS time, extract(epoch FROM (max(crossed_at) - min(crossed_at))) AS "Driving time" FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') GROUP BY driver ORDER BY driver

panels.description: Post-session driving-time compliance; compare with event regulations.
